other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (unorganised)
Must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a year
Applicant must not be a member of any other welfare fund
Applicant must not be a member of EPF, NPS or ESIC
Applicant must not be an income‑tax payer
For scheme benefits, applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Board or the child of such a worker
Applicant must be enrolled in an approved institute or university
Applicant must be pursuing education in the specified classes or vocational/technical courses
Stipend will not be granted for students who have failed in the final class of a level
benefits_summary: Provides stipends ranging from ₹3,000 to ₹70,000 depending on education level, with higher amounts for hostel residents
